propositions: A Jira issue's key changes when moved between projects but its numeric id does not, and rebar's bindings are keyed on the mutable key rather than the immutable id, causing bindings to silently detach when the old key stops resolving in moved_issue_key table
When a third-party app fails to update moved_issue_key during a project move, the old key 404s entirely and the absence probe orphans the local ticket from a live remote issue

The fix captures the numeric jira_id alongside the key on new bindings and re-asks by id on a key lookup miss, re-keying the binding to the current key if found, preserving the binding without rewriting the shared Cloud-facing store identity
The id fallback must not fire when the key still resolves normally, to avoid doubling every absence probe's cost during the happy path
Legacy bindings without a recorded id degrade safely to current behavior with no migration required, becoming eligible for id capture on next successful read
Cloud behavior must remain unchanged with no existing jira_key-taking method altered in signature or semantics, since the binding store is shared between Cloud and Data Center
